draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops 0.6, 1.3, 1.8 points at 10/20/30% noise, all within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion. The claim is supported and appropriately hedged ("appears somewhat robust").
